status: Layout specimen — synthetic rows, not a scored evaluation

metrics.formula: Manual User Story rows that have at least one generated match, divided by the count of manual User Story rows.
metrics.name: Recall

metrics.formula: Generated User Story rows matched to a manual story, divided by (those matches + generated-only rows classified noise). Valid extras are excluded from the denominator.
metrics.name: Precision

metrics.formula: Count of manual User Story rows with no generated match. The report lists each row with a transcript reference.
metrics.name: Manual-only Stories

metrics.formula: Generated User Story rows with no manual match. valid_extra: the transcript states the requirement and the manual CSV does not. noise: the transcript does not state the requirement, or the row restates no distinct requirement. Classification must cite hallucination-detection-evaluator evidence. Disagreement between the two subagents is BLOCKED_CONFLICT, not an average.
metrics.name: Generated-only Stories (Valid Extras vs Noise)

metrics.formula: Matched pairs whose epic context agrees, divided by matched pairs where both sides have an epic context (preceding Epic row, else blank). Agree when Epic ID is equal and non-blank, or when both IDs are blank and the Epic titles are the same string. Pairs with epic context on only one side count as disagree. Zero comparable pairs → na.
metrics.name: Epic Agreement

metrics.formula: Matched pairs whose feature context agrees, divided by matched pairs where both sides have a feature context (preceding Feature row, or the User Story ID when that ID is the catalog Feature work item id). Agree when Feature ID is equal and non-blank, or when both IDs are blank and the Feature titles are the same string. One-sided context counts as disagree. Zero comparable pairs → na.
metrics.name: Feature Agreement

metrics.formula: Generated User Story rows whose Title is a short capability name (does not start with "As a") and whose Description matches "As a <role>, I need to <need>, so that <benefit>." divided by generated User Story rows. Pattern source: docs/intake/user-story-csv-rulebook.yaml title_formats.user_story and user_story.description_format. The prepare packet's structural signal is the default numerator; override only with a cited finding.
metrics.name: Title and Description Format Compliance

metrics.formula: Generated User Story rows whose captured role is a business role, divided by generated User Story rows.
metrics.name: Role Specificity

metrics.formula: Mean number of Acceptance Criteria bullets on manual User Story rows and on generated User Story rows, plus both totals. A bullet is a non-empty line in the Acceptance Criteria cell.
metrics.name: Acceptance Criteria Count

metrics.formula: Mean of per-story quality scores on generated User Story rows. A bullet scores only when it is one observable outcome, testable from the transcript, and the cell uses ASCII "- " bullets (rulebook acceptance_criteria.format). Score is 0-100. Do not award points for implementation detail.
metrics.name: Acceptance Criteria Quality

metrics.na_reason: Transcript states no negative or boundary for this fixture.
metrics.formula: Generated User Story rows whose Acceptance Criteria include the negative or boundary outcome the transcript states for that requirement, divided by generated User Story rows whose matched transcript span states a negative or boundary. When the transcript states none, na.
metrics.name: Negative and Boundary Coverage

metrics.formula: Generated User Story rows that state exactly one capability, divided by generated User Story rows. A split or merge recorded on a match is evidence of a granularity miss for every generated row in that match that stacks or fragments a capability.
metrics.name: Granularity

metrics.formula: Generated User Story rows that contain at least one claim the transcript does not support, divided by generated User Story rows. Every counted row needs a transcript locator showing the absence of support (the nearest related span, or an explicit note that no span exists). Unsupported epic or feature titles count as hallucinations.
metrics.name: Hallucination Rate

open_items: This page shows the report layout only.
Scores are fixture values, not an evaluation of any HeartStream transcript.
